messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up: CarePath wants a 6-week hosted POC. procurement needs a hard spend ceiling and asks if we can provide a temporary per-token cap + waive the monthly minimum for the pilot. looping Sales-Eng and RevOps.

Ethan (Sales-Eng): hosted only? any chance they want Dedicated?

Maya (AE): Hosted only. Workload is mostly embeddings (embed-2048-v1) ~11M tokens and ~2M tokens of chat. They expect an initial spike in week 2.

Lina (RevOps): Per-token overrides are doable but risky with spikes. Options: (A) per-token override + absolute token cap, (B) prepaid capped spend, (C) short coupon/tiered discount. Which does procurement want?

Maya (AE): They insist on a hard dollar ceiling tied to tokens. Proposed by customer: embeddings $0.000004/token (list $0.00001), chat $0.00006/token (list $0.00009), cap 15M tokens for the pilot, duration 6 weeks.

Lina (RevOps): need the usage curve to model margins and batching/KV cache effects. please share daily breakdown. Also, we'll require a signed POC MOU and security questionnaire before waiving minimums.

Maya (AE): Quick sketch: week1 2M, week2 6.5M, week3 3M, week4 2M, week5 2M, week6 0.5M = ~16M (they rounded to 15M for cap).

Lina (RevOps): rough calc at proposed rates = embeddings ~$44, chat ~$120 => ~$164 total. small absolute cost but need to account for throughput costs and margin. I'll open a Deal Desk ticket.

pricing-bot: :gear: Deal Desk template: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk-template. Include cost sim + POC MOU. Approvals may take up to 48h.

Davis (Legal): confirm data types. if any PHI, we need the questionnaire and potential DPA addenda before waiving min. Maya, confirm with customer.

Maya (AE): customer says de-identified clinical metrics only, no PHI. I'll request signed MOU + questionnaire today.

Marcos (Sales Manager): I'm comfortable with a short pilot exception provided: signed POC MOU, RevOps margin sign-off, cap limited to 15M tokens or 6 weeks, and Legal confirms no PHI. If those are met I'll approve.

Lina (RevOps): created DD-4728: CarePath hosted pilot request - per-token overrides for embeddings/chat, cap 15M tokens, duration 6 weeks, waiver of monthly min for pilot. Link: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/DD-4728. Attaching the usage sketch.

pricing-bot: :white_check_mark: Ticket created: DD-4728. Attach MOU and questionnaire for review.

Maya (AE): uploading MOU v1 + questionnaire to DD-4728 now. will ping when done.

Lina (RevOps): updated ticket received. Running detailed sim (including caching/batching). Will post margin % and recommended limit. Also suggest adding an 80% notification and auto-throttle at 100% cap.

Davis (Legal): reviewing questionnaire. if everything looks clean I'll sign off on no-PHI. otherwise we'll need a narrow DPA clause.

Marcos (Sales Manager): contingent approval: if margin hit < 10% and Legal OK on data classification.

Lina (RevOps): margin sim complete: estimated cost $180, margin impact negligible. recommending approval with conditions: override limited to first 15M tokens, pilot auto-stops at cap or after 6 weeks, waive monthly min for pilot only.

Marcos (Sales Manager): approved. Lina, sign the DD ticket and note conditions.

pricing-bot: DD-4728 status: approved by RevOps + Sales Manager. Please finalize one-off rate card and MOU addendum.

Ethan (Sales-Eng): I'll draft the one-off rate card and MOU clause (hard cap + auto-stop + 80% alert) and post for sign-off.

Maya (AE): thanks team. i'll coordinate procurement signature and confirm start date once MOU is finalized. :rocket:
